_meta.source_of_truth: sprintf templates in production policies/*.rego supplied on 2026-11-17
_meta.note: Exact full-message matching. Literal spelling is intentionally preserved, including "atleast" in backup_resilience.rego. CONTROL-SET is a configuration finding, not one of the eight catalogue controls. message_audit.csv had observed text discrepancies and is not used to override policy source.

templates.template: %s: %s: %s is false, so public access to the bucket is not fully blocked
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ .+?\ is\ false,\ so\ public\ access\ to\ the\ bucket\ is\ not\ fully\ blocked$

templates.template: %s: %s: %s is not known at plan time, cannot verify
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ .+?\ is\ not\ known\ at\ plan\ time,\ cannot\ verify$

templates.template: %s: %s: database instance is publicly accessible
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ database\ instance\ is\ publicly\ accessible$

templates.template: %s: %s: publicly_accessible is not known at plan time, cannot verify
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ publicly_accessible\ is\ not\ known\ at\ plan\ time,\ cannot\ verify$

templates.template: %s: %s: backup_retention_period is %d, automated backups are disabled (minimum %d)
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ backup_retention_period\ is\ -?\d+,\ automated\ backups\ are\ disabled\ \(minimum\ -?\d+\)$

templates.template: %s: %s: backup_retention_period is not set to a known value at plan time; set it explicitly to atleast %d
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ backup_retention_period\ is\ not\ set\ to\ a\ known\ value\ at\ plan\ time;\ set\ it\ explicitly\ to\ atleast\ -?\d+$

templates.template: %s: context.deployment: no control set defined for context '%s'; every control is evaluated
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ context\.deployment:\ no\ control\ set\ defined\ for\ context\ '.+?';\ every\ control\ is\ evaluated$

templates.template: %s: %s: S3 bucket must use KMS encryption (sse_algorithm aws:kms)
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ S3\ bucket\ must\ use\ KMS\ encryption\ \(sse_algorithm\ aws:kms\)$

templates.template: %s: %s: S3 bucket has no server-side encryption configuration
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ S3\ bucket\ has\ no\ server\-side\ encryption\ configuration$

templates.template: %s: %s: RDS instance must set storage_encrypted = true
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ RDS\ instance\ must\ set\ storage_encrypted\ =\ true$

templates.template: %s: %s: EBS volume must set encrypted = true
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ EBS\ volume\ must\ set\ encrypted\ =\ true$

templates.template: %s: %s: EC2 block device must set encrypted = true
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ EC2\ block\ device\ must\ set\ encrypted\ =\ true$

templates.template: %s: %s: EC2 instance has no explicitly encrypted root_block_device
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ EC2\ instance\ has\ no\ explicitly\ encrypted\ root_block_device$

templates.template: %s: %s: policy allows all actions on all resources
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ policy\ allows\ all\ actions\ on\ all\ resources$

templates.template: %s: %s: attaches the AdministratorAccess managed policy
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ attaches\ the\ AdministratorAccess\ managed\ policy$

templates.template: %s: %s: KMS encryption must use a customer-managed key, not an AWS-managed or default key
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ KMS\ encryption\ must\ use\ a\ customer\-managed\ key,\ not\ an\ AWS\-managed\ or\ default\ key$

templates.template: %s: %s: RDS must use a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_id)
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ RDS\ must\ use\ a\ customer\-managed\ KMS\ key\ \(kms_key_id\)$

templates.template: %s: %s: EBS volume must use a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_id)
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ EBS\ volume\ must\ use\ a\ customer\-managed\ KMS\ key\ \(kms_key_id\)$

templates.template: %s: %s: EC2 block devices must use a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_id)
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ EC2\ block\ devices\ must\ use\ a\ customer\-managed\ KMS\ key\ \(kms_key_id\)$

templates.template: %s: %s: KMS key must set enable_key_rotation = true
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ KMS\ key\ must\ set\ enable_key_rotation\ =\ true$

templates.template: %s: %s: retains logs for %d days, less than the SCOF baseline of %d days
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ retains\ logs\ for\ -?\d+\ days,\ less\ than\ the\ SCOF\ baseline\ of\ -?\d+\ days$

templates.template: %s: %s: retention period is not known at plan time, cannot verify
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ .+?:\ retention\ period\ is\ not\ known\ at\ plan\ time,\ cannot\ verify$

templates.template: %s: context.deployment: no deployment context supplied; region cannot be evaluated
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ context\.deployment:\ no\ deployment\ context\ supplied;\ region\ cannot\ be\ evaluated$

templates.template: %s: context.deployment: unknown deployment context '%s'
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ context\.deployment:\ unknown\ deployment\ context\ '.+?'$

templates.template: %s: provider.%s: uses region %s, which is not allowed for context %s
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ provider\..+?:\ uses\ region\ .+?,\ which\ is\ not\ allowed\ for\ context\ .+?$

templates.template: %s: provider.%s: region is not a literal value, cannot verify for context %s
templates.regex: ^.+?:\ provider\..+?:\ region\ is\ not\ a\ literal\ value,\ cannot\ verify\ for\ context\ .+?$
